en.headline: Kwai Chung Hospital opens city’s first dedicated psychiatric block for under-18s
en.dek: The redeveloped main and child-and-adolescent blocks provide 1,000 beds and a ‘therapeutic village’ design; most services have already moved, with remaining relocation due by September.
body: The Hospital Authority said the redeveloped Kwai Chung Hospital’s new main block and child-and-adolescent block are now in service, giving Hong Kong its first facility dedicated exclusively to psychiatric care for patients under 18.

Hospital chief executive Dr Cheng Koi-man said the environment itself forms part of treatment. The enlarged campus increases floor area from about 80,000 to 134,000 square metres and offers 1,000 psychiatric beds, roughly one-quarter of the authority’s total. Wards include six-bed and single rooms with greater spacing, and each has access to outdoor space under the therapeutic-village concept.

The child-and-adolescent block consolidates outpatient, day-hospital and inpatient services that were previously scattered. The hospital receives about 3,000 new child and adolescent cases a year. Most clinical services have already relocated; the remaining moves are expected to finish within September before the old blocks are demolished for a rehabilitation garden.

zh.headline: 葵涌醫院新大樓啟用 設全港首個精神科兒童青少年服務座
zh.dek: 重建後主座及兒童青少年服務座提供1,000張病床，引入治療村概念；絕大部分服務已遷入，餘下預計9月完成。
body: 醫管局表示，葵涌醫院重建第二期新主座大樓及兒童及青少年服務座已分階段投入服務，成為全港首個專為18歲以下病人而設的精神科設施。
醫院行政總監鄭蓋民表示，環境本身就是治療的一部分。新大樓總建築樓面面積由約8萬平方米增至13.4萬平方米，提供約1,000張精神科病床，佔醫管局總數約四分之一。病房設六人房及單人房，床距加大，並採用治療村概念提供更多室內外活動空間。
兒童及青少年服務座集中門診、日間醫院及住院服務，方便一站式分流及跨專業治療。院方每年接收約3,000宗兒童及青少年新症。絕大部分服務已完成搬遷，餘下預計9月內完成，其後舊大樓將拆卸改建為病人復康花園。
